title: Wasm manifest (web/pkg/modules.js)
description: The data exports of web/pkg/modules.js, written during `mise run build:wasm` (or build:wasm:debug) (REQ-MANIFEST-010). modules.js is an ES module, not JSON: it also exports `imports`, an object of module name to a function returning `import("./<module>/glyphplot.js")`, which no JSON can hold and this schema leaves out. The site boots from `charts`, the shell's `moduleOf()` reads `modules` and `fallback`, and `chart(type, init)` loads a type's module at most once a page (REQ-LOAD-010). `budgets` is also written as web/pkg/budgets.json.

charts.description: Every chart type's meta, in registry order.

modules.description: The module that plays each chart type: its family in a release build, `all` in the debug build (REQ-MANIFEST-020).

additionalProperties.description: A module name: a folder of web/pkg holding glyphplot.js and glyphplot_bg.wasm.

fallback.description: The module asked for a type that `modules` does not list (the debug charts): `all` in the debug build, null in a release build.

budgets.description: Each module, with what it may cost; the same object as web/pkg/budgets.json.
